acceptanceCriteria: Each item has its own ticket or a recorded decision not to pursue it, with the measurement that decided it.
No rc.3 artifact advertises any of these as delivered.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Items decision 0523 defers past rc.3: a per-basis rank against K deterministic null spans seeded by patchSha256 with a BH-corrected per-hunk fraction (needs a labelled held-out set from another repository); optional author anchor offsets on the wire, only if P0 precision against human labels warrants it; a frozen mutant-operator table so discriminate counts are recomputable, and pinning the coverprofile as a Git blob by OID plus sha256 (both need cases in the 0.3 packet); the preregistered reviewer trial run (about 180 pairs for 80% power) after kill criterion K1 has a baseline, owner-commissioned.
title: cem/1.0 post-rc.3: seeded permutation specificity rank, author anchor hints, frozen mutant enumeration, coverprofile blob pin, and the registered reviewer trial run
